mathematics.assertion_tested: For the fixed C003 kick amplitude and DE clock rate, test exact single-kick angle-integrated escape and enclosed-mass retention in stationary isotropic tracer ensembles in prescribed NFW potentials.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64 with scipy quadrature and seeded numpy PCG64 sampling
mathematics.conventions: NFW Phi=-A ln(1+x)/x, zero at infinity. A fixed by supplied anchor escape speed; equilibrium sigma derived, not fitted. Eddington DF energy cut E>=psi(100) preserves stationarity. All tagged particles receive isotropic Poisson kicks with vk650 and G0=.382508632299176; static host in its rest frame.
inputs: supplied anchor x=.5,1.19,2.2,2.71 and vesc250,480,900,2600 km/s
non_claims: Not a self-consistent N-body, MOND, action-derived, evolving, accreting, or cosmological simulation.
Fixed NFW potential cannot establish C003 real-world viability or kill every action completion.
Input sigmas are mutually inconsistent with isotropic NFW equilibrium at the given vesc and anchor.
Retained bound probability is not enclosed-mass retention.
All tagged particles remain eligible for kicks even after escape; no multistream or local clock-frame coupling is derived.
Normal confidence intervals quantify independent particle sampling only; do not cover model error or timestep bias.
